copy.storyHeading: We stopped taking landed homes in 2021
story: Ruang Murni started in 2019 taking any work we could get. Within two years it was clear that condo units were where we were genuinely better than everyone else — and that treating them as small houses was why most contractors got them wrong.

So we stopped taking landed work entirely. Everything we know now is about units under 1,200 square feet: where storage hides, what management corporations require, and how to finish in forty-five days without your neighbours filing a complaint.

process.title: Measure & Quote
process.text: We measure your actual unit, not the developer's floor plan — they are rarely the same. Package pricing is by square footage, so you know the cost range before the first meeting ends.

process.title: 3D & Approvals
process.text: A full 3D walkthrough video you can watch at home and share with family. Meanwhile we handle the management corporation submission, deposit, lift booking and permitted working hours.

process.title: Build in 45 Days
process.text: Condo work has rules — noise hours, lift access, debris removal — and we schedule around all of them so your neighbours stay friendly. Most units complete in about forty-five days.
